title: Signed tensor symmetry by K-flat descent on the small pro-etale site
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme and use its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Let $V$ be a Grothendieck abelian symmetric monoidal closed category, with monoidal preadditive tensor, functorial flat resolutions. Use the ordinary unbounded derived tensor $\mathcal T_T$ of [def-weil-derived-tensor], with its canonical left-derived comparison $\mu_T$ from the homotopy tensor. Define $s_T:\mathcal T_T^{\mathrm{flip}}\to\mathcal T_T$ by the two-variable left-derived universal lift of the signed homotopy-complex braiding through $\mu_T$: its defining representative arrow is the flipped $\mu_T$ followed by the localization of the flipped Koszul braiding. Thus its component with indices $(L,K)$ has source $K\otimes^L L$ and target $L\otimes^L K$. Define $\sigma_{K,L}=(s_T(L))(K)$. In particular, for $V=\operatorname{Mod}(A)$ this is the signed derived tensor swap for constant coefficient modules, with the cochain sign $(-1)^{ij}$ on degrees $i,j$. These are definitions on arbitrary unbounded objects, with no compact-support or exceptional-adjoint datum.
